name: JANUS/TRUMP TIME-TRAVEL CROSS-CHAT HANDOFF

purpose.primary: Allow any future ChatGPT conversation to reconstruct how Hawkar and JANUS/TRUMP work across chat-context limits without restarting the research, guessing state, or duplicating frozen gates.
purpose.secondary: Separate durable workflow law from a non-authoritative checkpoint snapshot so the protocol remains useful after the research branch advances.
activation_phrase_examples: Load the JANUS/TRUMP TIME-TRAVEL JSON and continue STATUS-FIRST.
Сошлись на TIME-TRAVEL JSON и восстанови контур.

CANONICAL_LOCATIONS.rule: The protocol file tells the next chat HOW to recover; the live Janus-Fundamentum branch tells it WHERE the research actually is now.

TIME_TRAVEL_MODEL.stable_layer: This protocol: roles, tools, epistemic firewalls, message-passing choreography, verification rules, stop rules, and recovery algorithm.
TIME_TRAVEL_MODEL.dynamic_layer: Live GitHub branch HEAD plus its newest canonical artifacts and immutable parent lineage.
TIME_TRAVEL_MODEL.checkpoint_rule: Any checkpoint stored inside this JSON is historical only. Never assume it is still HEAD. STATUS-FIRST against GitHub overrides it.

CROSS_CHAT_BATON_WORKFLOW.description: One chat proposes or authorizes exactly one scoped gate. Hawkar copies that message into the algorithm/research chat. That chat performs the gate and returns a structured STATUS-FIRST report with Git provenance. This chat independently verifies the canonical commit/artifact, compresses the next missing obligation, and sends the next baton.
CROSS_CHAT_BATON_WORKFLOW.message_rule: The copied message is an authorization/specification baton, not proof authority. Canonical proof state comes from sealed artifacts and verified source bindings.

steps: Fetch the exact live branch HEAD from GitHub.
Compare it with the handoff/checkpoint SHA.
Search for the exact requested successor artifact/gate before creating anything.
If successor exists, inspect it and do not duplicate it.
If branch advanced for another reason, read the intervening lineage before acting.
Never rewrite historical frozen artifacts to make later knowledge look preregistered.
Continue append-only from the actual live state.
STATUS_FIRST_PROTOCOL.race_condition_rule: Repeat STATUS-FIRST immediately before a write. If another chat created the successor meanwhile, abort duplicate creation and inspect the existing successor.

GITHUB_PROVENANCE_LAW.source_of_truth: GitHub exact objects for project state.
verify_after_user_reports_result: confirm immutable preregistration was not rewritten
inspect workflow runs only when scientific execution is relevant
GITHUB_PROVENANCE_LAW.write_policy: When Hawkar asks to save/seal and GitHub write access exists, perform a real repository write; never claim persistence from chat text alone.

GitHub_connector.role: Canonical repository state, commits, files, diffs, branches, provenance, append-only writes.
GitHub_connector.priority: Use for JANUS/TRUMP project state instead of public web search.

web_TOPA.role: Current public literature and prior-art search; theorem/source refresh; post-publication developments.
rules: Use targeted source queries around the exact current missing lemma.
Prefer primary papers and authoritative sources.
ARBITRARY_BASE_RESULT != FIXED_STS31_RESULT unless reduction is proved.

Files_connector.role: Recover user/library/conversation files when content is needed; persistent handoff artifacts outside GitHub when relevant.
Files_connector.rule: Search/read files instead of guessing unseen content.

Python_exact_or_symbolic_support.role: Private algebra checks, finite sanity tests, counterexample search, exact symbolic arithmetic when useful.
Python_exact_or_symbolic_support.firewall: A computation or finite test is not asymptotic proof unless an exact proof/certificate is separately established.

Captain_Obvious.pipeline: STATUS -> TARGET -> GAP -> KILLER_TEST -> GATE -> CERTIFY -> PROMOTE_ONLY_WHAT_WAS_PROVED
Captain_Obvious.habit: Before attacking a strong object, ask whether a strictly weaker object is already sufficient.

TOPA_Spider.role: Target-driven literature/citation/prior-art expansion around one exact open edge.
TOPA_Spider.rule: Do not broaden into general reading when a narrower theorem binding would decide the gate.

LEDGERS.DISCOVERY_LEDGER: Ideas, analogies, associations, candidate mechanisms. No proof authority.
LEDGERS.FORMALIZATION_LEDGER: Explicit mathematical objects with metaphor removable. Still no theorem promotion by itself.
LEDGERS.PROOF_LEDGER: Proved lemmas, exact exhaustive certificates with domain coverage, independent verification, counterexamples, scoped theorem states.

BA16_IDENTITY_COLLAPSE_DIAGNOSTIC.use: Look for maps from apparent states to effective identities, but collapse only when future-relevant semantics are exactly preserved.

SPIRAL_PROTOCOL.geometry: ORIGIN -> EXPLORE -> MIRROR -> SOURCE -> RETURN -> ORIGIN_PRIME
SPIRAL_PROTOCOL.ORIGIN: Name the exact current open edge.
SPIRAL_PROTOCOL.EXPLORE: Generate only mechanisms that could close or falsify that edge.
SPIRAL_PROTOCOL.MIRROR: Attack hidden state explosion, coefficient blowup, approximation drift, identity collapse errors, and unproved implications.
SPIRAL_PROTOCOL.RETURN: Translate surviving mechanisms back into the frozen project object.
SPIRAL_PROTOCOL.ORIGIN_PRIME: Remove metaphor and leave one formal next obligation.

GATE_DISCIPLINE.first_future_break: For any compressed state, find the earliest reachable point where it may cease to be closed. Prefer this over large empirical sweeps.
GATE_DISCIPLINE.stop_on_first_new_statistic: When the first higher-order/missing statistic appears, freeze it and stop rather than silently building an unbounded hierarchy.

verdicts.PASS: Only the exact preregistered target is proved under its stated complexity and semantic contract.
verdicts.OPEN_NO_PROOF_NO_FALSIFIER: No proof and no rigorous global falsifier. This is a valid informative result.
verdicts.FAIL: Only a rigorous falsifier of the whole frozen target, not failure of one candidate mechanism.

GATE_DISCIPLINE.promotion_rule: A local PASS closes only that local edge. Parent/global claims require separate composition/promotion gates.

MESSAGE_TEMPLATE_FOR_NEXT_CHAT.first_instruction: STATUS-FIRST. Read this TIME-TRAVEL protocol, then inspect the live Janus-Fundamentum branch before doing any mathematical work.
must_report_first: whether the named next gate already exists
latest canonical artifact if branch advanced
MESSAGE_TEMPLATE_FOR_NEXT_CHAT.then: Continue from the newest canonical stop using exactly one next gate.

RECOVERY_ALGORITHM_FOR_CONTEXT_LOSS: 2. Fetch the live Janus-Fundamentum research branch HEAD.
3. Read the HEAD commit and newest research artifact(s).
4. Follow direct-parent lineage backward only as far as needed to recover immutable preregistration and the immediately preceding proof/falsification result.
5. Extract STATUS, proved objects, killed candidates, surviving candidates, exact next missing link, next gate, and stop rule.
6. Verify scientific firewalls H1/H2/H3/SAT_IN_P/P_VS_NP before responding.
7. Run Captain Obvious: ask whether the stated next object can be weakened while still sufficient, but never rewrite already-frozen history.
8. Use TOPA only if current source refresh/prior art can materially change the gate.
9. Return one baton message that authorizes the next exact gate.
10. After Hawkar returns its result, independently verify GitHub and repeat.

CURRENT_CHECKPOINT_SNAPSHOT_NONAUTHORITA.warning: THIS SNAPSHOT MAY ALREADY BE STALE. LIVE GITHUB STATUS-FIRST HAS AUTHORITY.

CURRENT_MATHEMATICAL_ROUTE_SUMMARY_AT_SN.route: STS31_LEVI_BASE -> HPS_RAMANUJAN_COVER_SELECTOR -> spectral_gap -> linear_treewidth -> existing frozen reducer adapter
proved_local_reductions: Sign of Delta at separation-safe z_r is sufficient to choose a good child.
Exact carried parent scalar is not required; CURRENT_PREFIX_IS_GOOD is a theorem invariant.
At fixed future completion sibling determinant difference equals Tr(adj(K)R) with rank<=2 trace-zero R and degree at most N-2.
First generic overlapping rank-one update introduces C2(u,a;K)-C2(v,a;K), and trace-zero antisymmetry does not cancel it generically.
Fixed compound order k has polynomial dimension O(r^k); appearance of C2 or C3 alone is not a complexity blocker.
CURRENT_MATHEMATICAL_ROUTE_SUMMARY_AT_SN.current_core_question: For the ACTUAL earliest reachable HPS weighted star overlap, does the mixed second-compound Delta correction admit exact polynomial-size/update closure at order <=2, or what is the first exact higher-order statistic required?

DO_NOT_DO_ON_RECOVERY: Do not open Lane C, holdouts, or BA26 unless a later canonical artifact explicitly authorizes them.
Do not generate SAT instances or run reducer/treewidth sweeps merely to feel progress.
Do not replace exact proof obligations with finite numerics.
Do not silently weaken frozen target A or reinterpret B as a pass for A.
Do not treat generic matrix counterexamples as HPS-specific falsifiers without reachability/binding.
Do not duplicate a gate that another chat already sealed.
Do not claim a file/commit was saved unless the write is actually verified.

HUMAN_OPERATOR_NOTE.usage: If a conversation is near its context limit, Hawkar can tell the next chat to load this JSON. The next chat must then reconstruct live state from GitHub rather than asking Hawkar to manually retell the entire research history.
HUMAN_OPERATOR_NOTE.recommended_short_command: Братик, восстановись по JANUS/TRUMP TIME-TRAVEL JSON, сделай STATUS-FIRST и продолжи с live HEAD.
